title: Reading
description: Import a passage, generate questions, and practice comprehension.
disabledNoWorkspace: Create a workspace before adding reading passages.
importDescription: Paste text or upload a PDF/DOCX file, then review before saving.
deleteConfirmDescription: This removes the passage and all of its question sets and attempts.
emptyDescription: Import a short article, story, or lesson text to start reading practice.
generateDescription: Create a saved question set from this passage. Reopening later will not regenerate.
noSets: No question sets yet. Generate one to start practicing.
unansweredWarn: Some questions are unanswered. Submit anyway?
gradingPending: Written answers could not be fully evaluated. Your answers were saved — you can retry grading later.
selectWordHint: Select a word or short phrase in the passage to add it to vocabulary.
uploadHint: PDF or DOCX up to 10 MB. Text-based PDFs work best.

errors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: This passage is too long. Shorten it and try again.
errors.SCANNED_PDF: This PDF looks scanned or image-only. Paste the text instead, or use a PDF with a text layer.
errors.INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Use a PDF or DOCX file.
errors.OPENAI_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI is not configured on this server.
errors.GENERATION_FAILED: Could not generate questions. Try again.
errors.GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE: AI quota reached or AI is unavailable.
errors.SET_NOT_READY: This question set is not ready yet.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
